Braced Charge.name: Braced Charge
Braced Charge.description: The user braces and charges until their next turn, with a rising whine and bright muzzle glow, then fires within thirty meters. The shot deals heavy bludgeoning damage and knocks an adult down; held back, it only knocks them back. The user cannot fire while charging, and firing without a brace knocks the user down too. Strain: moderate.
